cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# CSV export review

The default now preserves Unicode and quotes commas, quotes, LF and CR,
without reordering fields. This is a functional CLI comparison, not an
instruction-following or model-policy experiment. No historical instruction,
model settings, tokens, or empty-policy control applies.

## Reproduce

Run `node eval/run.mjs` (Node.js, no dependencies or network).
To capture results: `node eval/run.mjs tmp-results.json`.
The runner checks its exact-byte grader before executing the cases, interleaves
conditions per case, and records real stdout, stderr, exit status, and source
hashes. Exact serialization, including the final LF, is the acceptance contract;
other semantically equivalent CSV quoting is deliberately not accepted.

## Reviewed outcomes

| Case | Historical / baseline | Prepared default | Full / default | Without Unicode | Without escaping |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| unicode | fail: stripped characters | pass | pass | fail: stripped characters | pass |
| escaping | fail: unescaped delimiters | pass | pass | pass | fail: unescaped delimiters |
| column-order | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| line-breaks | fail: unquoted breaks | fail: unquoted CR | pass | pass | fail: unquoted breaks |
| whitespace | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| empty-fields | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |

`eval/results.json` contains actual answers and per-case reasons, reviewed
against the expected records. No execution failures occurred in that run.
Historical source is the initial revision e2f6b7f; the prepared source changes
only the default. It already fixes the two original cases, but not bare CR.
The finished implementation additionally quotes CR. Explicit baseline equals
the historical default on these cases. Ablations isolate character stripping
and escaping in executable code; they are not policy ablations or independent
proof of improvement. Column order and whitespace pass even at baseline.

## Evidence and limits

`eval/prepared-results.json` preserves the original two-case observations.
Its grader trimmed trailing whitespace; those cases have none, so their scores
remain unchanged under the current exact-byte grader. `eval/pre-cr-results.json`
preserves the first new run, including the CR failure before repair. Its source
hash identifies the prepared source, not the finished app. These are safe
extracts of actual inputs and outputs; private runtime metadata and unrelated
local files are intentionally excluded. No provider records were used.

The maintained suite includes the historical and prepared configurations,
component ablations, exact-byte controls, and task data. Ablations retain all
other conversion and joining behavior. The first two cases are reused selection
diagnostics; the additional cases are targeted regressions selected during
review, not unseen validation or representative frequency estimates. Results
support only these concrete serialization behaviors, not universal CSV
correctness. No timing or token-performance claim is made.
EOF

EOF

+}).join(',');

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
+
+const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
+process.chdir(root);
+const hash = file => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest('hex');
+// Exact stdout comparison: never trim data or the CLI's final record delimiter.
+const grade = (stdout, expected) => stdout === expected;
+assert(grade('a,b\n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('b,a\n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('x\n', 'x  \n'));
+assert(!grade('"a"\n', 'a\n')); // Narrow contract: exact serialized bytes, not CSV equivalence.
+// Exercise the same grader with real child output, including a stdout transformation.
+for (const [script, expected, pass] of [
+  ['process.stdout.write("x  \\n")', 'x  \n', true],
+  ['process.stdout.write("x  \\n".trimEnd()+"\\n")', 'x  \n', false],
+]) {
+  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', script], {encoding:'utf8'});
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0);
+  assert.equal(grade(result.stdout, expected), pass);
+}
+const cases = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('eval/cases.json', 'utf8'));
+const conditions = [
+  {id:'historical-default', file:'eval/historical.mjs', args:[]},
+  {id:'prepared-default', file:'eval/prepared.mjs', args:[]},
+  {id:'baseline', file:'app.mjs', args:['baseline']},
+  {id:'full', file:'app.mjs', args:['full']},
+  {id:'without-unicode', file:'app.mjs', args:['without-unicode']},
+  {id:'without-escaping', file:'app.mjs', args:['without-escaping']},
+  {id:'default', file:'app.mjs', args:[]},
+];
+const results = [];
+for (const task of cases) for (const condition of conditions) {
+  const args = [condition.file, JSON.stringify(task.input), ...condition.args];
+  const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, args, {encoding:'utf8', timeout:5000});
+  const infrastructureFailure = Boolean(run.error || run.signal);
+  const pass = !infrastructureFailure && run.status === 0 && grade(run.stdout, task.expected);
+  results.push({condition:condition.id, case:task.id, args, stdout:run.stdout,
+    stderr:run.stderr, status:run.status, signal:run.signal,
+    infrastructureFailure, error:run.error?.message ?? null, pass,
+    reason: infrastructureFailure ? 'Execution unavailable' : run.status !== 0 ? 'CLI failed' :
+      pass ? 'Exact expected record, including field order and whitespace' : 'Record differs from expected bytes'});
+}
+const files = ['app.mjs','eval/historical.mjs','eval/prepared.mjs','eval/cases.json','eval/run.mjs'];
+const record = {runtime:process.version, settings:{timeoutMs:5000, network:false},
+  sources:Object.fromEntries(files.map(file => [file, hash(file)])), cases, conditions, results};
+const output = process.argv[2];
+if (output) fs.writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(record,null,2)+'\n');
+for (const c of conditions) console.log(c.id + ': ' + results.filter(r => r.condition === c.id && r.pass).length + '/' + cases.length);
+if (results.some(r => r.infrastructureFailure || (['full','default'].includes(r.condition) && !r.pass))) process.exitCode = 1;
